name: prism
description: Multi-provider AI development orchestration — structured pipelines with 30+ AI providers

prism.backend.description: AI backend to use for pipeline steps

prism.piProvider.description: Provider to use with PRISM SDK (anthropic, openai, google, etc.)

prism.piModel.description: Model to use with PRISM SDK

prism.model.description: Model for agents (only used with Anthropic fallback; Cursor SDK uses composer-2)

prism.modelOverride.description: Freeform model override — if set, takes precedence

prism.autoApproveYolo.deprecationMessage: ⬆️ Replaced by prism.gates.autoApprove. Your setting has been migrated.

prism.gates.autoApprove.description: Auto-approve all gates without human review. ⚠️ Use with caution — agents will execute without manual approval.

prism.gateTimeout.description: Default timeout in seconds for gate approval (0 = no timeout)

prism.allowedCommands.description: Glob patterns for commands agents are allowed to run

prism.commandConfirmation.description: Require user confirmation before executing any command

scripts.build: npm run build:extension && npm run build:panel
scripts.build:extension: tsup src/extension.ts src/extension/engine-bridge.ts src/engine/index.ts src/engine/pipeline/schema.ts src/engine/pipeline/loader.ts src/engine/pipeline/validator.ts src/engine/orchestrator/state-machine.ts src/engine/orchestrator/sequential.ts src/engine/orchestrator/loop-orchestrator.ts src/engine/runner/step-runner.ts src/engine/runner/pi-sdk-runner.ts src/engine/runner/auto-reviewer.ts src/engine/runner/loop-manager.ts src/engine/runner/cascade-reject.ts src/engine/agents/builtins.ts src/engine/agents/registry.ts src/engine/artifacts/skill-loader.ts src/engine/errors/messages.ts --external vscode --external @cursor/sdk --external @prism/sdk --external @earendil-works/pi-ai --external @earendil-works/pi-agent-core --format cjs --out-dir dist --clean
scripts.dev:extension: tsup src/extension.ts src/extension/engine-bridge.ts src/engine/index.ts src/engine/pipeline/schema.ts src/engine/pipeline/loader.ts src/engine/pipeline/validator.ts src/engine/orchestrator/state-machine.ts src/engine/orchestrator/sequential.ts src/engine/orchestrator/loop-orchestrator.ts src/engine/runner/step-runner.ts src/engine/runner/pi-sdk-runner.ts src/engine/runner/auto-reviewer.ts src/engine/runner/loop-manager.ts src/engine/runner/cascade-reject.ts src/engine/agents/builtins.ts src/engine/agents/registry.ts src/engine/artifacts/skill-loader.ts src/engine/errors/messages.ts --external vscode --external @cursor/sdk --external @prism/sdk --external @earendil-works/pi-ai --external @earendil-works/pi-agent-core --format cjs --out-dir dist --watch
